dialogues.speaker: Basu
dialogues.text: You crusty two-bit hustler! Tryin' to muscle in on our route? Mess up the Boss's shipment to Nasha Town, and you'll have to liquidate your whole crew just to cover what you owe!

dialogues.speaker: Hoyka
dialogues.text: Pfft, liquidate? I'll freeze your whole crew solid and then walk off with the goods!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, it looks they're going to start a fight over there!
